papers.title: Improvement of fatigue resistance and ductility of TiAl6V4 processed by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Institute of Materials Research, German Aerospace Center, Cologne, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Galina Kasperovich
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Materials Research, German Aerospace Center, Cologne, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化Ti6Al4V的疲劳性能，但未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡等生物力学问题，仅作为工艺和材料性能参考。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on solid Ti6Al4V fatigue improvement without porous structure design, stress shielding analysis, or osseointegration context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高SLM钛合金的疲劳抗性和延展性
summary_zh.method: 通过工艺参数优化和后处理改善微观结构
summary_zh.result: 显著提升了疲劳寿命和塑性变形能力

summary_en.motivation: To improve the fatigue resistance and ductility of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Optimization of processing parameters and post-treatment to refine microstructure and reduce defects.
summary_en.result: Substantial enhancement in fatigue life and elongation compared to as-built condition.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing including tensile and high-cycle fatigue tests.
